This plot is very small, just a little piece near my home, and I grow mixed crops on it together. I do not buy chemical fertilizer for it — I save that for my bigger fields if at all, but mostly I use manure from my animals because it is cheaper and good for the mixed crops. I plant the seeds I save from last year, as I have always done for these crops. At my age, I work it myself with help from my family, and I do not spend money on hired workers for such a small piece.
